labels.py /active-label ownership check uses in-memory 'any(...)' over get_labels_for_user(user); 404 works but returned message text is Indonesian ('Label tidak ditemukan pada akun ini') — good UX and doesn't leak whether the label exists elsewhere.

label_package_service.py enforces optimistic concurrency (expected_revision) and audit trail on package changes — good. Requires expires_on for annual packages (including multi_label) — the review-request curl example needs to include this or it 422s.

Not tested to fail here because mlqa fixture provisions KYC on both children; flagging as design consideration only.

If the seed_demo_labels script is updated to fully KYC-verify the demo labels, re-run /app/backend/tests/test_iter92_multi_label.py — expected result is all 8 non-skipped tests PASS. To re-exercise the free-WAMI branch, remember to cleanup+seed the MLQA fixture each time (WAMI 400s idempotently once the track has an active order).
rca of the issue: Two failing single-label regression tests all trace to the same root cause: seed_demo_labels.py provisions balance & releases but not the KYC artifacts (label.logo_storage_key, bank_accounts.verification_status='verified'). ensure_label_kyc() in kyc_service therefore returns status='incomplete' with missing_keys=['logo','bank'], and require_label() (deps.py line 75-77) enforces KYC on /api/label/account and /api/releases/submission-quota because those paths are not in KYC_ALLOWED_LABEL_PREFIXES. Mitigation: extend seed_demo_labels to also set logo_storage_key + a verified bank record; alternatively, add /api/label/account to KYC_ALLOWED_LABEL_PREFIXES (design call — a Multi Label owner might legitimately want to see the account summary before completing KYC on every child).
